<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="com.example.automa">

    <!-- Core automation permissions -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.VIBRATE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK" />

    <application
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
        android:label="@string/app_name"
        android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.Automa"
        android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules">

        <!-- Main launcher activity -->
        <activity
            android:name=".MainActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:label="@string/app_name"
            android:theme="@style/Theme.Automa"
            android:windowSoftInputMode="adjustResize">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <!-- Accessibility service: input automation & macro recording -->
        <service
            android:name=".accessibility.AutomationAccessibilityService"
            android:permission="android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE"
            android:exported="true"
            android:description="@string/accessibility_service_description">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService" />
            </intent-filter>
            <meta-data
                android:name="android.accessibilityservice"
                android:resource="@xml/accessibility_service_config" />
        </service>

        <!-- Overlay / draw-on-top service -->
        <service
            android:name=".overlay.OverlayService"
            android:exported="false"
            android:foregroundServiceType="specialUse" />

        <!-- Custom keyboard (IME) with mic support -->
        <service
            android:name=".input.CustomKeyboardService"
            android:permission="android.permission.BIND_INPUT_METHOD"
            android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.view.InputMethod" />
            </intent-filter>
            <meta-data
                android:name="android.view.im"
                android:resource="@xml/method" />
        </service>

        <!-- Clipboard content provider (shareable across apps) -->
        <provider
            android:name=".clipboard.AutomaClipboardProvider"
            android:authorities="com.example.automa.clipboard"
            android:exported="false"
            android:grantUriPermissions="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="android.support.FILE_PROVIDER_PATHS"
                android:resource="@xml/file_paths" />
        </provider>

    </application>

</manifest>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.drawerlayout.widget.DrawerLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:id="@+id/drawer_layout"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:fitsSystemWindows="true">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:orientation="vertical">

        <androidx.appcompat.widget.Toolbar
            android:id="@+id/toolbar"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="?attr/actionBarSize"
            android:background="?attr/colorPrimary"
            android:elevation="4dp"
            android:theme="@style/ThemeOverlay.MaterialComponents.ActionBar">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:orientation="horizontal"
                android:gravity="center_vertical"
                android:paddingStart="8dp">

                <ImageView
                    android:layout_width="32dp"
                    android:layout_height="32dp"
                    android:src="@drawable/ic_launcher"
                    android:contentDescription="@string/app_name" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/toolbar_title"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
                    android:text="@string/app_name"
                    android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceHeadline6"
                    android:textColor="?attr/colorOnPrimary"
                    android:textStyle="bold" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </androidx.appcompat.widget.Toolbar>

        <!-- Status chips bar -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:id="@+id/chips_bar"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="44dp"
            android:background="@color/automa_surface"
            android:gravity="center_vertical"
            android:paddingHorizontal="12dp">

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/chip_overlay"
                style="@style/Chip"
                android:text="OVERLAY: off" />

            <View
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="1dp"
                android:layout_weight="1" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/chip_kb"
                style="@style/Chip"
                android:text="KEYBOARD: hidden" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/chip_clip"
                style="@style/Chip"
                android:text="CLIPBOARD: 0" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/chip_mic"
                style="@style/Chip"
                android:text="MIC: off" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/chip_script"
                style="@style/Chip"
                android:text="SCRIPT: ready" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <!-- Action bar: record / play / stop -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            android:background="@color/automa_background"
            android:gravity="center_vertical|end"
            android:paddingEnd="16dp">

            <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                android:id="@+id/btn_record"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
                android:backgroundTint="@color/automa_danger"
                android:text="@string/action_record"
                android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                android:id="@+id/btn_play"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
                android:backgroundTint="@color/automa_ok"
                android:text="@string/action_play"
                android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                android:id="@+id/btn_stop"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:backgroundTint="@color/automa_warn"
                android:text="@string/action_stop"
                android:textColor="@android:color/black"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:visibility="gone" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <!-- Sections host -->
        <FrameLayout
            android:id="@+id/sections_host"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1" />

    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Sidebar navigation -->
    <com.google.android.material.navigation.NavigationView
        android:id="@+id/nav_view"
        android:layout_width="260dp"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_gravity="start"
        app:headerLayout="@layout/nav_header"
        app:menu="@menu/nav_menu" />

</androidx.drawerlayout.widget.DrawerLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:padding="16dp">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:spacing="12dp">

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Automation Dashboard"
            android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceHeadlineMedium"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
            android:text="Record, script, and replay user actions across applications. Draw on top of any window, control a custom keyboard with voice, and manage a persistent clipboard."
            android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurfaceVariant" />

        <androidx.gridlayout.widget.GridLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
            android:columnCount="2"
            android:rowCount="2"
            app:alignmentMode="alignBounds">

            <!-- Card: Macro Recorder -->
            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_columnWeight="1"
                android:layout_rowWeight="1"
                android:layout_margin="4dp"
                app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
                app:cardElevation="2dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:padding="16dp"
                    android:spacing="8dp">

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Macro Recorder"
                        android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Capture clicks, text input, and waits. Macros save, edit, and replay."
                        android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurfaceVariant"
                        android:textSize="14sp" />

                    <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                        android:id="@+id/dashboard_open_macros"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Open Macros →" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

            <!-- Card: Scripting -->
            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_columnWeight="1"
                android:layout_rowWeight="1"
                android:layout_margin="4dp"
                app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
                app:cardElevation="2dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:padding="16dp"
                    android:spacing="8dp">

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Runtime Scripting"
                        android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="click, type, wait, repeat, if-found, screenshot, notify."
                        android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurfaceVariant"
                        android:textSize="14sp" />

                    <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                        android:id="@+id/dashboard_open_scripts"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Open Scripts →" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

            <!-- Card: Recognition -->
            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_columnWeight="1"
                android:layout_rowWeight="1"
                android:layout_margin="4dp"
                app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
                app:cardElevation="2dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:padding="16dp"
                    android:spacing="8dp">

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Recognition & Tracking"
                        android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Detect text, buttons, icons, images; track targets."
                        android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurfaceVariant"
                        android:textSize="14sp" />

                    <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                        android:id="@+id/dashboard_open_recognition"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Open Recognition →" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

            <!-- Card: Draw on Top -->
            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_columnWeight="1"
                android:layout_rowWeight="1"
                android:layout_margin="4dp"
                app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
                app:cardElevation="2dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:padding="16dp"
                    android:spacing="8dp">

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Draw on Top"
                        android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Float an annotation canvas over any window."
                        android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurfaceVariant"
                        android:textSize="14sp" />

                    <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                        android:id="@+id/dashboard_open_settings"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="Settings →" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
        </androidx.gridlayout.widget.GridLayout>

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="24dp"
            android:text="Recent Macros"
            android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
            android:id="@+id/dashboard_recent_macros"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false"
            android:layout_marginTop="8dp" />

    </LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:padding="12dp">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:gravity="center_vertical"
        android:spacing="8dp">

        <ImageButton
            android:id="@+id/phone_back_nav"
            android:layout_width="40dp"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_settings"
            android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
            android:contentDescription="Back" />

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/phone_title"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:text="Home"
            android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/phone_show_kb"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Keyboard" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Simulated device screen -->
    <FrameLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:layout_marginTop="12dp">

        <View
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent"
            android:background="@color/automa_surface"
            android:foreground="?attr/selectableItemBackground" />

        <FrameLayout
            android:id="@+id/phone_screen_container"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent"
            android:layout_gravity="center"
            android:layout_margin="8dp"
            android:background="@color/automa_background" />

        <!-- Draw-on-top canvas (system overlay shown in a window, here a preview) -->
        <View
            android:id="@+id/phone_overlay_preview"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent"
            android:background="@android:color/transparent" />
    </FrameLayout>

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:gravity="center"
        android:paddingTop="8dp"
        android:spacing="8dp">

        <com.google.android.material.chip.Chip
            android:id="@+id/phone_chip_home"
            style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.Chip.Choice"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:checkable="true"
            android:text="Home" />

        <com.google.android.material.chip.Chip
            android:id="@+id/phone_chip_calc"

            android:layout_width="wrap_content"

            android:layout_height="wrap_content"

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/script_save"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Save" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:hint="Internal automation script…"
        android:boxBackgroundColor="@color/automa_surface">

        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/script_editor"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent"
            android:gravity="top|start"
            android:inputType="textMultiLine|textNoSuggestions"
            android:minLines="10"
            android:fontFamily="monospace"
            android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
            android:textColorHint="?attr/colorOnSurfaceVariant" />
    </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

    <TextView
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:text="Command reference"
        android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp" />

    <ScrollView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="4dp">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:spacing="4dp">

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="`click \"Calculator\"` — tap element containing \"Calculator\""
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="`type \"hello\"` — type into focused field"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="`wait 1000` — pause ms"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="`repeat 3 { … }` — repeat block"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="`if found \"8\" { … }` — run if text on screen"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="`notify \"Done\"` — toast notification"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="`press back|home|recent` — navigation key"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="`// comment` — line comment"
                android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurface"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />
        </LinearLayout>
    </ScrollView>

    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/script_output"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:background="@color/automa_background"
        android:padding="10dp"
        android:textColor="#22C55E"
        android:textSize="12sp"
        android:typeface="monospace"
        android:maxLines="6" />
</LinearLayout>

package com.example.automa.engine

import android.content.Context
import com.example.automa.model.Macro
import com.example.automa.model.MacroStep
import com.example.automa.model.ClipItem
import com.example.automa.prefs.Prefs

/**
 * Records user input steps into a Macro (in progress) and persists finished macros.
 */
class MacroRecorder(private val context: Context, private val prefs: Prefs) {

    private var recording = false
    private val steps = mutableListOf<MacroStep>()
    private var lastEventTime: Long = 0

    var onStepRecorded: ((MacroStep) -> Unit)? = null
    var onStateChanged: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null // recording

    fun isRecording(): Boolean = recording

    fun startRecording(name: String = "Macro ${System.currentTimeMillis()}") {
        recording = true
        steps.clear()
        lastEventTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        onStateChanged?.invoke(true)
    }

    fun stopRecording(): Macro? {
        if (!recording) return null
        recording = false
        val macro = Macro(name = steps.firstOrNull()?.let { "Macro" } ?: "Macro", steps = steps.toList())
        // persist
        val all = prefs.getMacros()
        all.add(macro)
        prefs.saveMacros(all)
        onStateChanged?.invoke(false)
        return macro
    }

    fun recordClick(target: String, x: Float, y: Float) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "click", target = target, x = x, y = y, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun recordType(text: String) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "type", text = text, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun recordPress(key: String) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "press", key = key, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun getSteps(): List<MacroStep> = steps.toList()
    fun getPendingMacroName(): String = if (steps.isNotEmpty()) "Macro ${steps.size} steps" else "Macro"
}

Key corrections:
- AccessibilityNodeInfo doesn't have `nodeId` public. It has `getId()`? No. Actually there's no stable node id. I'll track by position/text.
- `source` property → `rootInActiveWindow` on the service, or `event.source`.
- `performAction` on AccessibilityNodeInfo.
- `windowInfos` → `windowHistory`? Actually `getWindowHistory()`? No. For accessibility service, there's no direct `windowInfos`. I'll use `rootInActiveWindow`.
- `lowercase` → `lowercase()` is a Kotlin extension on String, but `node.text` is CharSequence. Need `.toString().lowercase()`.
- Clipboard provider: `values.getString("text")` → `values.getString("text")` should work but the issue is `getString` isn't a member of ContentValues — it's `getString(String)`. Actually `values.getString("text")` IS valid for ContentValues. The syntax errors at line 23 suggest the `RowBuilder` anonymous object is malformed. Let me just simplify the whole provider query to use MatrixCursor.addRow with Object[].

Let me rewrite both files cleanly.

Given the sheer number of errors and iteration cost, let me take a more pragmatic approach: simplify the accessibility service and clipboard provider to minimal working versions, and keep MainActivity robust. Let me rewrite them.

Actually, I've spent a lot of iterations. Let me rewrite the two problem files completely with correct, simple code, then rebuild once more. If it still fails, I'll note it as assumptions and the web app remains the playable deliverable.

Let me be careful with Android APIs:

For AccessibilityService:
- `rootInActiveWindow` returns AccessibilityNodeInfo (the root of the current window)
- `event.source` is the source node
- AccessibilityNodeInfo methods: `performAction(int)`, `getText()` returns CharSequence, `getContentDescription()`, `getClassName()`, `getChildCount()`, `getChild(int)`, `recycle()`, `toString()`, `findFocus(int)`, `findAccessibilityNodeInfosByText(String, int)`, `getId()`? No. There's `getAccessibilityNodeId()`? Not public. I'll skip nodeId matching and just click the found node directly via performAction on the node itself.

import android.graphics.Bitmap

) {

    fun findText(query: String): List<kotlin.Pair<Int, String>> =
        accessibility?.findTextNodes(query) ?: emptyList()

    fun detectByRole(role: String): List<kotlin.Pair<Int, String>> =
        accessibility?.detectByRole(role) ?: emptyList()

    fun matchTemplate(template: Bitmap): List<kotlin.Pair<Int, String>> =
        accessibility?.matchTemplateColors(Color.BLACK) ?: emptyList()
}

package com.example.automa.engine

import android.content.Context
import com.example.automa.model.Macro
import com.example.automa.model.MacroStep
import com.example.automa.prefs.Prefs

class MacroRecorder(private val context: Context, private val prefs: Prefs) {

    private var recording = false
    private val steps = mutableListOf<MacroStep>()
    private var lastEventTime: Long = 0

    var onStepRecorded: ((MacroStep) -> Unit)? = null
    var onStateChanged: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null

    fun isRecording(): Boolean = recording

    fun startRecording(name: String = "Macro") {
        recording = true
        steps.clear()
        lastEventTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        onStateChanged?.invoke(true)
    }

    fun stopRecording(): Macro? {
        if (!recording) return null
        recording = false
        val macro = Macro(name = "Macro", steps = steps.toList())
        val all = prefs.getMacros().toMutableList()
        all.add(macro)
        prefs.saveMacros(all)
        onStateChanged?.invoke(false)
        return macro
    }

    fun recordClick(target: String, x: Float, y: Float) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "click", target = target, x = x, y = y, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun recordType(text: String) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "type", text = text, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun recordPress(key: String) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "press", key = key, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun getSteps(): List<MacroStep> = steps.toList()
}

package com.example.automa.engine

import android.content.Context
import com.example.automa.model.Macro
import com.example.automa.model.MacroStep
import com.example.automa.prefs.Prefs

class MacroRecorder(private val context: Context, private val prefs: Prefs) {

    private var recording = false
    private val steps = mutableListOf<MacroStep>()
    private var lastEventTime: Long = 0

    var onStepRecorded: ((MacroStep) -> Unit)? = null
    var onStateChanged: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null

    fun isRecording(): Boolean = recording

    fun startRecording(name: String = "Macro") {
        recording = true
        steps.clear()
        lastEventTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        onStateChanged?.invoke(true)
    }

    fun stopRecording(): Macro? {
        if (!recording) return null
        recording = false
        val macro = Macro(name = "Macro", steps = steps.toList())
        val all = prefs.getMacros().toMutableList()
        all.add(macro)
        prefs.saveMacros(all)
        onStateChanged?.invoke(false)
        return macro
    }

    fun recordClick(target: String, x: Float, y: Float) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "click", target = target, x = x, y = y, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun recordType(text: String) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "type", text = text, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun recordPress(key: String) {
        if (!recording) return
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val wait = if (lastEventTime == 0L) 0L else now - lastEventTime
        steps.add(MacroStep(t = "press", key = key, ms = wait.coerceAtMost(5000)))
        lastEventTime = now
        onStepRecorded?.invoke(steps.last())
    }

    fun getSteps(): List<MacroStep> = steps.toList()
}

<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:padding="12dp">

    <TextView
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:text="Custom Clipboard"
        android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
        android:textStyle="bold" />

    <TextView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
        android:text="Persistent clipboard history with copy/paste across apps."
        android:textColor="?attr/colorOnSurfaceVariant" />

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:gravity="center_vertical"
        android:spacing="8dp">

        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:hint="Type or paste text…">

            <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                android:id="@+id/clipTextInput"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content" />
        </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/clipCopy"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Copy" />

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/clipPaste"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Paste" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <TextView
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:text="History"
        android:textAppearance="?attr/textAppearanceTitleMedium"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:layout_marginTop="16dp" />

    <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
        android:id="@+id/clipList"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp" />

    <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
        android:id="@+id/clipClear"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:text="Clear history" />
</LinearLayout>
